name: Luxury Cottage Blue Mountains
address: 125 Craigmore Crescent,  The Blue Mountains, Ontario, Canada
description:
Luxury Cottage at Blue Mountain Ski Resort

Escape in luxury just 5 minutes from Blue Mountain Village and Northwinds Beach, the perfect getaway for adventure seekers that want a unique stay. This retreat provides the ultimate rest and relaxation atmosphere, tucked away on a quiet street close to restaurants, hiking, biking, and the sparkling waters of Georgian Bay. Have year-round fun by changing out your paddleboards for ski poles and exchange warm summer days at the beach for a night out on the slopes. You’re less than 10 minutes from enjoying a day on the golf course, unwinding at Scandinavian Spa or exploring everything Scenic Caves offers. Only 15 minutes to downtown Collingwood and Thornbury, you’ll want to extend your trip to fit in everything the area has to offer.

Make your way through the front door to reveal the open-concept design with incredible attention to every detail. You’ll find the living room to your left before making your way to the breathtaking kitchen and dining area with expansive windows that allow natural light to pour in while enjoying the mountain view. You’ll love the secondary bar that opens up to the outdoor kitchen, complete with a built-in BBQ and mini-fridge. With extravagant design indoors and a spectacular backyard, you’ll have an incredible stay, rain or shine.

The kitchen is a showstopper with a stunning waterfall island with breakfast bar, built-in wine cooler, 9 ft high cabinetry, built-in dishwasher, double oven, two stoves, and S/S appliances. Take in the views of the lush greenery from the forestry and mountain landscape while preparing your meal. If you prefer an evening of privacy, you can close the blinds and enjoy a fireside atmosphere with the feature wall.

Catch up with friends and family or relax with a movie night on the large flat-screen TV. You’ll never miss an opportunity for a great view in this home with the large windows featuring mountain views. With a generously sized space, it’s easy to bring out the board games or enjoy early morning yoga while the sunlight pours in.

Upstairs you’ll find 3 spacious bedrooms with ensuite privilege and an office overlooking the kitchen area with access to the upper balcony. The primary suite offers a King bed, a private walk-out balcony, a large walk-in closet and 4 piece bath with double sinks, a walk-in shower, and soaker tub. The second bedroom has a queen bed and the third hosts two single beds for additional guests that connect to a separate 4 piece ensuite.
